requirement: Describe your incident response procedures and SLAs for P1 security events.
Confirm your platform supports SSO via SAML 2.0 and OIDC.
Detail your data residency options for the EU and UK.
Provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report.
Outline encryption at rest and in transit, including key management.
State your support hours and response time targets.
Describe your business continuity and disaster recovery process and RPO/RTO.
List third-party sub-processors and their function.
Provide pricing structure for 100, 500, and 5000 users.
Outline the contractual liability cap.
Describe the audit logging available to customer admins.
Confirm support for customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK / CMK).
Detail penetration testing cadence and remediation policy.
Describe role-based access control and least-privilege enforcement for internal staff.
Provide implementation timeline and onboarding milestones.
Detail the data retention and deletion policy upon contract termination.
Confirm compliance with GDPR and provide the DPA.
Describe the change management process for product releases.
Provide your uptime track record for the last 12 months and credit schedule for misses.
List integration options: REST API, webhooks, SCIM, and supported standards.
Describe how mobile access is supported and whether MDM is required.
Confirm whether end-user data is used to train models.
Detail your secure SDLC practices.
Provide references from at least two enterprise customers of comparable size.
Outline your insurance coverage and limits.
Describe your roadmap for quantum-resistant cryptography. ((no source))
State your CMMC level 3 attestation status. ((no source))
Provide a written confirmation that you operate in low-earth orbit datacenters. ((no source))
Detail the price you would charge for a 50-million-user deployment in 2032. ((no source))
Describe how your platform implements homomorphic encryption for analytics queries. ((no source))
